newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bovespa investigates deals in Thursday's session.
newsitem.headline: Bovespa investigates deals in Thursday's session.

text.p: The Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said it is looking into deals made in Thursday's trading session, which was marked by heavy trade and high volatility.
Gilberto Mifano, Bovespa's superintendant, said the exchange always investigates when any unusual movement happens.
Earlier today Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) asked the bolsa to provide explanation on yesterday's trade.

He recognized that volatility in the last half hour of the session was unusual as a strong selling pressure on top blue-chips led the bolsa to lose ground sharply before it recovered to rise 1.09 percent at the close.
The selling pressure coincided with the futures index settlement on local futures exchange Bolsa de Mercadorias e de Futuros (BM&F).

Mifano said Bovespa and BM&F together would look into all buy and sell orders in both exchanges to verify if there was any irregularity. He expects to conclude the investigations Tuesday and provide the explanation requested by the CVM.
